title: The Altar of Burnt Offering, the Basin, the Courtyard, and a Summary of the Materials
description: Bezalel and Oholiab made the altar of burnt offering from acacia wood overlaid with bronze, the basin from bronze mirrors of the women who served at the entrance to the tent of meeting, and the courtyard with hangings of finely twisted linen, posts, and bases. The chapter ends with a summary of the materials used: gold, silver, and bronze collected from the people, counted out by Moses' command under the supervision of Itamar, Aaron's son.
